audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Nicodemus, born from above/anew ambiguity, water and Spirit, Spirit/wind wordplay, lifted Son of Humanity, world/cosmos love, light/judgment, John witness about bridegroom and above/from earth contrast.

verses.restored: There was a person from the Pharisees, Nicodemus by name, a ruler of the Judeans.

familiar.text: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

verses.restored: This one came to him by night and said to him, Rabbi, we know that you have come from the Divine as teacher, for no one is able to do these signs you do unless the Divine is with him.

familiar.text: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to him, Amen, amen, I say to you: unless someone is born from above/anew, one is not able to see the reign of the Divine.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

verses.restored: Nicodemus says to him, How is a human able to be born when old? Is one able to enter a second time into the mother's womb and be born?

familiar.text: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

verses.restored: Jesus answered, Amen, amen, I say to you: unless someone is born of water and Spirit, one is not able to enter the reign of the Divine.

familiar.text: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.restored: What has been born from ordinary human nature is ordinary human nature; what has been born from the Spirit is spirit.

familiar.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

verses.restored: Do not marvel that I said to you, You must be born from above/anew.

familiar.text: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

verses.restored: The wind/Spirit blows where it wills, and you hear its voice, but you do not know from where it comes or where it goes. So is everyone born from the Spirit.

familiar.text: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

verses.restored: Nicodemus answered and said to him, How are these things able to happen?

familiar.text: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to him, You are the teacher of Israel, and you do not know these things?

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: we speak what we know and bear witness to what we have seen, and you do not receive our witness.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

verses.restored: If I told you earthly things and you do not trust, how will you trust if I tell you heavenly things?

familiar.text: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

verses.restored: No one has ascended into heaven except the one who descended from heaven, the Son of Humanity.

familiar.text: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

verses.restored: Just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so it is necessary for the Son of Humanity to be lifted up,

familiar.text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

verses.restored: so that everyone trusting in him may have age-long life.

familiar.text: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

verses.restored: For the Divine loved the world in this way: he gave the only Son, so that everyone trusting into him may not perish but may have age-long life.

familiar.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.restored: For the Divine did not send the Son into the world to judge the world, but so that the world might be saved/healed through him.

familiar.text: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

verses.restored: The one trusting into him is not judged; the one not trusting has already been judged, because that one has not trusted into the name of the only Son of the Divine.

familiar.text: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

verses.restored: This is the judgment: the light has come into the world, and humans loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were harmful.

familiar.text: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

verses.restored: For everyone practicing worthless/harmful things hates the light and does not come toward the light, so that one's works may not be exposed.

familiar.text: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

verses.restored: But the one doing the truth comes toward the light, so that one's works may be revealed, because they have been worked in the Divine.

familiar.text: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

verses.restored: After these things Jesus and his disciples came into the Judean land, and there he remained with them and baptized.

familiar.text: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

verses.restored: John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because much water was there; people were coming and being baptized.

familiar.text: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

verses.restored: For John had not yet been thrown into prison.

familiar.text: For John was not yet cast into prison.

verses.restored: A discussion arose from John's disciples with a Judean about purification.

familiar.text: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.

verses.restored: They came to John and said to him, Rabbi, the one who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have borne witness, look, this one is baptizing, and all are coming to him.

familiar.text: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

verses.restored: John answered and said, A human is not able to receive anything unless it has been given from heaven.

familiar.text: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

verses.restored: You yourselves bear me witness that I said, I am not the Messiah, but I have been sent before that one.

familiar.text: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

verses.restored: The one having the bride is the bridegroom; the friend of the bridegroom, standing and hearing him, rejoices with joy because of the bridegroom's voice. Therefore this joy of mine has been fulfilled.

familiar.text: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

verses.restored: That one must increase; I must decrease.

familiar.text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

verses.restored: The one coming from above is above all. The one being from the earth is from the earth and speaks from the earth. The one coming from heaven is above all.

familiar.text: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

verses.restored: What he has seen and heard, this he bears witness to, and no one receives his witness.

familiar.text: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

verses.restored: The one receiving his witness has sealed that the Divine is true.

familiar.text: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

verses.restored: For the one whom the Divine sent speaks the words of the Divine, for he gives the Spirit without measure.

familiar.text: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

verses.restored: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into his hand.

familiar.text: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

verses.restored: The one trusting into the Son has age-long life; the one refusing the Son will not see life, but the wrath of the Divine remains upon that one.

familiar.text: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
